idea-plugin.name: Omarchy Theme Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Keeps JetBrains IDE appearance in sync with the active Omarchy theme.

When you switch themes with omarchy-theme-set, this plugin reads ~/.config/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml and reskins the IDE: it regenerates the editor color scheme from the theme's ANSI palette and retints the IDE UI (light/dark plus common surfaces). It validates that the machine is actually running Omarchy and stays completely dormant otherwise.
